written: 2026-11-04, by hand from Companies House, the Norwegian register and the companies' own sites, before any run. Every fact and its source is in ground-truth.md.

The unsettled company passes when kept, sent to check by hand, or dropped only for the problem types it accepts. Extra problem types are listed as notes, not failed: several planted companies have more than one true problem, and the key holds only the ones ground-truth.md proves.
